title: Amazon Stock (AMZN) Falls 1.7% on Anthropic IPO Filing (Nov 11)
summary: Amazon (AMZN) fell 1.74% to $266.17 on Nov 11 as the Nasdaq rose 1.60%, with financial media tying the drop to Anthropic's amended IPO filing.
body_markdown:
## Why Amazon Stock Fell


As reported by[GuruFocus](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/amazon-stocks-move-lower-1-191029536.html) , which tied Wednesday's decline to the document, an amended Anthropic filing describes how AWS convertible notes convert into Class N shares when the[initial public offering](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/learn/what-is-an-ipo/) closes, with up to 276,827,518 shares going to AWS, subject to an ownership cap. GuruFocus noted that Class N shares carry economic rights but no general voting power.[SEC EDGAR](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2130357/000162828026072484/0001628280-26-072484-index.htm) lists Anthropic's latest amended registration statement (Form S-1/A) as filed on November 10.


The stake behind those notes is large. According to[24/7 Wall St.](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/amazon-google-sitting-411-billion-204745481.html) , a Reuters calculation puts Amazon's and Alphabet's combined Anthropic stakes at $411 billion if shares price at $78, the top of the $70 to $78 range, with about $271.8 billion of that held by Amazon against $18.0 billion invested. The outlet said Amazon's notes bar it from holding more than 12% of Anthropic's capitalization, so another 1,563,617,444 shares will be issued later, and that neither company has commented on the figure.


Separately, in a report published after Wednesday's close,[Simply Wall St.](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/amazon-amzn-could-face-trial-221016549.html) said Italian prosecutors are reportedly targeting Amazon's European unit and its managers over alleged unpaid import VAT and customs duties on non-EU goods sold through its marketplace. Italian authorities have yet to decide whether to send the case to trial, and the report carried no response from Amazon.


## AMZN Stock Analysis: Supporting Factors and Risks


### Supporting Factors


- AWS revenue rose 39% to $45.98 billion and its growth accelerated for a sixth straight quarter, according to 24/7 Wall St., which said Amazon management projects AWS growth above 40% in 2027 and 2028.
- Anthropic runs workloads on AWS Trainium chips, per GuruFocus, which said Anthropic's final IPO price will set the first public mark for Amazon's stake.


### Risks


- Amazon expects approximately $220 billion in 2026 cash capital expenditures, and its trailing 12-month free cash flow is negative $42.4 billion versus positive $14.8 billion a year earlier, according to[TIKR](https://finance.yahoo.com/economy/policy/articles/democrats-could-target-data-center-201808689.html) .
- Baird Strategas policy strategist Daniel Clifton said Democrats could push to end 100% expensing for data center equipment, a change TIKR said could raise near-term cash taxes, though no formal proposal exists.
- The stake values remain scenarios until Anthropic prices its shares, and the Class N shares give Amazon no control, per 24/7 Wall St.
- The Italian import VAT case could still lead to a trial of Amazon's European unit and its managers.


Anthropic expects to price its[IPO](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/news/anthropic-ipo-opens-retail-allocation-australia-offering-up-to-20-retail/) on November 18 and begin trading on Nasdaq as ANT on November 19, per 24/7 Wall St.
